name: The Silver River
desc1: The rippling surface of the river appears to be molten silver,
desc2: shimmering mysteriously in the mist. Occasionally a loud splash can be
desc3: heard, quickly followed by strange shadows moving within the water.
desc4: Looming above you to the south are the rocky walls of the Dragon's
desc5: Teeth hills, the mazelike mountains west of Silvermere. To the north,
desc6: a forbidding mass of dark trees block entrance to a shadowy wood.
desc7: There is no place to land on either shore.
